This lightwall PTFE tubing has a low permeability to gasses and liquids. It resists degradation from most chemicals and is hydrophobic, meaning it is impervious to water and substances containing water. PTFE resists UV light and corrosion as well, making it weatherproof, waterproof, and ideal for outdoor and marine use. Lightwall PTFE tubing is flexible and has excellent crack and stress resistance. It can be used across a broad range of operating temperatures and has the highest continuous use temperature of any fluoropolymer, up to 260C (500F). With smoothbore, extruded interior walls and the lowest coefficient of friction of any polymer, lightwall PTFE tubing ensures restriction-free flow no matter how hot or cold your environment gets. Thanks to its superior heat and chemical resistance ratings, it is widely used for aerospace and military applications where fuels burn hotter and stakes are higher. PTFE can be used as jacketing on long runs of thin, individual wires where bundling isnt a priority or necessary. Its high dielectric strength makes it a superb choice for insulating electrical connections, protecting critical components, or shielding sensitive parts. PTFE offers some of the best cut-through and abrasion resistance around. It is smooth, hard, and dramatically improves impact strength and lifespans on installations. Lightwall PTFE can be sterilized or custom printed for easy labeling and identification. For many industries, lightwall PTFE helps equipment and instruments be smaller, thinner, and safer with slimmer profiles. This lightwall tubing also helps protect wires, cords, cables, and connections around the home or garage.

Lightwall PTFE can be sterilized or custom printed for easy labeling and identification. For many industries, lightwall PTFE helps equipment and instruments be smaller, thinner, and safer with slimmer profiles. description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

title: 1/4" Heat Shrink Tubing Adhesive Lined 3:1 Ratio | 6" Len, 500Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Cold Shrink Tubing Cold shrink tubing is a rubber sleeve that has been stretched over a removable plastic core at the factory. Slide it over the cable, pull out the core, and the tube contracts to grip whatever is underneath. Nothing gets heated, so there is no heat gun, no torch and no risk of scorching nearby insulation. Our cold shrink tube is made from EPDM rubber and cut to 6" lengths in eight diameters. How to Install Cold Shrink Tubing Pick the size whose application range covers the outside diameter of your cable, splice or connector (see the size chart below).; Slide the tube over the cable and position it over the area you want to cover.; Pull the loose end of the core strip. The core unwinds in a spiral and the tube shrinks down behind it. You can pull from either end of the tube.; Keep pulling until the whole core is out. The installation is done. description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). title: 1/2" Adhesive Lined Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Ratio | 1- 1/4" Len, 500Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. title: 1/4" Adhesive Lined Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Ratio | 1.75" Length, 500Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

title: 1/8" Adhesive Lined Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Ratio | 7" Len, 1000Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

title: 3/16" Adhesive Lined Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Ratio | 4 3/4" Len 1000Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Features of F6 wrap Sleeving: The Limiting Oxygen Index (LOI) is a measure of the ratio of Oxygen to other gases in the air surrounding a substrate. title: 1/4" Heat Shrink Tubing Adhesive Lined 3:1 Ratio | 3" Len, 500Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

Lightwall PTFE can be sterilized or custom printed for easy labeling and identification. For many industries, lightwall PTFE helps equipment and instruments be smaller, thinner, and safer with slimmer profiles. description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

title: 1" Heat Shrink Tubing Adhesive Lined 3:1 Ratio | 3/4" Length, 100Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Our versatile 3:1 thin-wall heat shrinkable tubing is also available with an Adhesive, "dual-wall" construction. Dual-wall is made by combining two different materials. The outer wall is Polyolefin heat shrink, and the inner wall is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of normal heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow, just like hot melt glue. When the tubing shrinks and cools down, this inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate, thus the name "adhesive-lined" heat shrink tubing. title: 1/2" Heat Shrink Tubing Adhesive Lined 3:1 Ratio | 5" Len, 500Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Cold Shrink Tubing Cold shrink tubing is a rubber sleeve that has been stretched over a removable plastic core at the factory. Slide it over the cable, pull out the core, and the tube contracts to grip whatever is underneath. Nothing gets heated, so there is no heat gun, no torch and no risk of scorching nearby insulation. How to Install Cold Shrink Tubing Pick the size whose application range covers the outside diameter of your cable, splice or connector (see the size chart below).; Slide the tube over the cable and position it over the area you want to cover.; Pull the loose end of the core strip. The core unwinds in a spiral and the tube shrinks down behind it. You can pull from either end of the tube.; Keep pulling until the whole core is out. The installation is done. There is nothing to cure or heat.; Cold Shrink Tubing Sizes Size cold shrink by the application range, not by the as-supplied ID. The cable or component OD must fall between the minimum and maximum of the range so the tube grips tightly once the core is removed. title: 3/16" Adhesive Lined Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Ratio | 5/8" Len, 1000Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

title: 1/4" Adhesive Lined Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Ratio | 4 3/4" Len, 500Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

title: 1" Adhesive Lined Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Ratio | 2 1/4" Length, 100Pcs
description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.

description: Our 3:1 adhesive lined (Dual Wall) heat shrink pre cut pieces is also available with a "dual-wall" construction. It is called dual wall because it is actually made up of two different materials together. One wall - the outer wall - is Polyolefin heat shrink. The second wall (hence the name "dual wall") - the inner wall - is a hot melt adhesive. When exposed to heat (usually a bit lower than the activation temperature of the heat shrink), the inner layer begins to flow (just like a hot melt glue). When the tubing shrinks and cools down, inner layer forms an adhesion layer between the tubing and the component or wire. This provides a water-tight seal, protecting the connector and/or wire. It also allows the tubing to stick to the substrate. This is why this tubing is also called adhesive lined heat shrink tubing.
